limitations: Default encoder GOP/B-frame/async-depth policies differ; these results are not an equal-encoding-quality comparison.
Actual current renderer and encoder are recorded in each run's profile; PR459 uses Metal/VideoToolbox on macOS and Vulkan/Vulkan Video on Windows.
No API capture or Vulkan validation during timing; prior runtime diagnostics are separate.
macOS only: both implementations measured on the same M2 Max in this batch; Windows was not accessed or retested.
